notes: AI-first features (local Ollama, nothing leaves your PC): (1) Can-my-PC-run-X advisor with ~75 games including the full Dospara GALLERIA roster. (2) User memory - Helix remembers facts about you across sessions. (3) Morning briefing - once-a-day summary of overnight PC changes. (4) Error triage - paste any crash/BSOD/traceback and get a plain-English explanation with correlated Windows events. Website simplified to a single installer download. Builds are now produced by GitHub Actions on every push, so the exe always matches the latest source.
